notes: Facing: board row5 labels every upper-wing unit NE and every lower-wing unit SW (24 NE, 24 SW). The brochure site plan north arrow points straight up, so on the plan these windows face N and S; the board convention (NE/SW) is used because the site only allows NE/SE/SW/NW. Floor plans confirm living-room windows on those faces.

gt30m: board row3 col3 has 68 vector semicircles (radius about 14-15 m on plan, each with a 15m radius line), one on the window face of each of the 48 units plus 20 side-face semicircles on wing-end units. Decision: pass only if every semicircle centred on the unit is green (any red fails). Pass1 = vector fill colour; pass2 = fresh 900 dpi raster sampled near each apex (board_r3_900.png). 4 primary semicircles (201A-133, 201B-157, 201B-163, 204B-124) read green in pass2 because a neighbour green semicircle is drawn over half of them; zoom crops (dis_*.png) show their own red half, resolved red. 7 stacks with mixed red/green semicircles (200A-115, 200B-131, 200B-117, 201A-147, 201B-149, 204A-100, 204B-116) fail and are marked medium confidence.

centre_px = site-plan raster px (sp_146.png) of the window-face semicircle centre, mapped from the board (board image frame = full brochure page, 0.12137 board pt per page pt; verified by facility markers and unit outlines lining up).

Facilities near: board row2 30 m circles (28) with numbered labels; a stack is near when its plan footprint is within the circle. Legend mapping: 5 'Precinct pavilion with drop-off porch' -> Precinct pavilion + Drop-off porch; 8 'space reserved for future community use' -> Community space; 14 Restaurant and 15 Cafe -> Eating house (no exact canonical name); 11 Eating house, 12 Shops, 13 Supermarket are at the 1st storey of Block 201 (MSCP).
facilities_has: only Block 201B (Residents' network centre at 1st storey under stacks 161/163). Preschool is standalone Block 203; commercial is in Block 201 (MSCP).

roof_floors: every block's 2nd-storey plan (p16,19,22,25,28,31) carries 'ROOF AT 2ND STOREY ONLY' notes around the corridor/lift core and wing ends; per the board legend ('same floor as an accessible roof, e.g. roof at 2nd storey only') all stacks get [2]. The brochure does not itself call these roofs accessible. Accessible sky terraces (200A/201A storeys 9 and 29, 200B 20 and 40, 201B 22 and 36) and roof gardens above 201A (above 49), 201B stacks 149/151 (above 46) and 204B stacks 116/118 (above 33) are on floors with no units, so they are not counted.

chute_m: straight line from each main door to the nearest CENTRALISED REFUSE CHUTE box in the wash area (recyclable chute box sits 1 m further along), typical-floor pages 17/20/23/26/29/32. 200B and 201A share the same plan; 204A and 204B share the same plan. Doors read off zoomed renders, about +/-0.5 m.

position: board legend (p17, 200A) marks 113, 115, 111, 103, 105 corner and 109, 101, 107 corridor. Same rule applied to the mirrored layouts: the 4-room unit next to where the branch corridor leaves for the 2-room/3-room wing, and the first pair of that wing, are Corridor; dead-end units are Corner.

wind_open: footprint rays at bearings 90-135 deg (plan north up), 30 m, against footprints of the other residential blocks. Blocked: 200A-115 (200B 127 at about 27 m), 200B-119 and 200B-121 (201A 143 at about 25 m).

mscp_m: nearest distance from the stack footprint to the Block 201 building outline (the 6-storey MSCP with commercial 1st storey and its north podium), rounded to 5 m. Differs from mscp_distance.json (block centre to car-park strip) by more than 10 m for most stacks; see stack notes.

mrt_m: Telok Blangah MRT is at the board row1b point (red 100 m circle centre, plan px 974,219, by the station label). Distance from that point to the nearest point of the stack footprint, rounded to 5 m. Within 100 m: all 201A stacks and 200B 131, 117, 119, 121, 123.

Units: from pipeline/raw/berlayar-rise-7-dist.json (pages 13-15); re-checked against the p12 unit-mix table (1976 = 172 + 644 + 172 + 988) and p13 visually (200A sky terraces at 9 and 29, 200B at 20 and 40, 1st storey empty). No rental units are marked in the brochure.
